verdict.rationale: Gladia is an audio API platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is an applicable axis. A probe confirms a first-party MCP server documentation page under Gladia's 'how-to-use-gladia' docs, which directly supports connecting an agent. The evidence is only that existence check, with no detail on what the server does or how to set it up. Missing for 10: details of exposed MCP tools/capabilities, setup and auth instructions, supported agent clients, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
